THE EDITORIAL HANDOFFObserve → Teach → Calculate → Check → Present

For synthetic matches, Scout runs first from the verified evidence. Guide receives Scout. Vector then calculates from the same records. Check receives all three and runs a separate model execution whose bounded choice remains subordinate to the deterministic evidence gate. Host runs last with all four completed contributions. Public wording comes from the validated source catalog, so a model cannot invent arithmetic, citations or an unseen result. Follow-ups retain the previous round and add a new question, explanation or limit. Four Azure model requests per fresh synthetic round; up to four for a film discussion. Checkpoints and public receipts persist in Azure Blob Storage.

Photorealistic fictional AI presenters. Their public contributions come from the existing Azure AI discussion. These are generated portraits, not real human commentators.

THE LIVE CONTROL PATH

Protect. Verify. Recover. Deliver.

The same evidence contract follows a moment from ingestion to Watch and Pocket Director.

01Bound the event

Source, revision, playhead and evidence cutoff define what the system is allowed to know.

02Constrain tools

Specialists can request only registered calculations and source records for the current moment.

03Isolate handoffs

Scout, Guide, Vector, Check and Host execute separately with visible IDs, latency and delivery state.

04Gate every claim

Deterministic citation, number, attribution and correction checks run before audience publication.

05Review in Foundry

A project-scoped evidence court audits the public trace; it advises while the deterministic gate stays final.

06Publish least privilege

Watch, overlays and Pocket Director receive reviewed output through read-only, expiring delivery paths.

IMPLEMENTED · MICROSOFT ENTRA ID + AZURE RBAC

One identity. Four scoped roles.

The Container App uses a user-assigned managed identity. The public verification checks four assignments without exposing object IDs.

  • AcrPull for the runtime image.
  • Cognitive Services OpenAI User for crew inference.
  • Foundry User for the project-scoped referee.
  • Storage Blob Data Contributor for checkpoints and cached results.
IMPLEMENTED · EVIDENCE POLICY

Prompts cannot expand the evidence.

Viewer text is treated as a question, never as authority. The server chooses the source contract and refuses unknown tools, future records and incompatible revisions.

  • Claim citations must resolve before the current cutoff.
  • Numeric prose must match deterministic calculations.
  • Corrections withdraw affected movement claims while preserving unrelated event facts.
IMPLEMENTED · RESILIENT ORCHESTRATION

Failure stays visible and recoverable.

Each specialist is saved independently. If a worker stops, BTR reloads completed stages and spends requests only on unfinished work.

  • Durable Blob checkpoints survive service replacement.
  • Conditional ETag writes reject stale workers.
  • Failed, restored and newly executed stages remain distinct in the audit trail.
IMPLEMENTED · MICROSOFT FOUNDRY

A second line reviews the public trace.

The Foundry referee receives bounded public contributions, citations and claim records. It scores grounding, correction sensitivity, role value and release readiness.

  • Foundry never receives private chain-of-thought.
  • Its response ID, latency, usage and limitation are receipted.
  • It cannot override the deterministic release gate.
IMPLEMENTED · DELIVERY AUTHORITY

The audience cannot become the producer.

External broadcast rooms separate read and write capability. Pocket Director follows the live evidence revision without gaining permission to change production state.

  • HTTPS ingress and an explicit origin allowlist protect production actions.
  • Read-only session links expire and stop cleanly.
  • Overlay cues expire after six seconds; producer authority expires after thirty minutes.
IMPLEMENTED · PUBLIC TOOL RECEIPTS

Execution state is inspectable.

The AI Desk distinguishes a live model request from a restored replay, deterministic calculation, or failed-and-recovered stage.

  • Execution IDs, tools, evidence IDs and latency remain visible.
  • Rejected drafts do not become audience output.
  • Saved work is labeled instead of imitating fresh generation.
IMPLEMENTED · INGRESS + RESOURCE GUARDS

Anonymous traffic stays bounded.

The API derives its rate identity from the verified proxy side of the forwarding chain. Capacity is reserved before request bodies are read and released when validation or a client connection fails.

  • Rate identities expire independently and the in-memory table has a fixed ceiling.
  • Live match streams have per-run and service-wide subscriber limits.
  • Disconnected editorial streams cancel ordinary model work and release capacity.
IMPLEMENTED · DATA RETENTION

Checkpoints have an end date.

Agent records carry application retention deadlines. Expired records are deleted when encountered, while the Azure Storage lifecycle policy removes the remaining agent blobs after two days.

  • Production proof authorization deletes an expired session record.
  • Ordinary AI checkpoints expire after twenty-four hours.
  • The lifecycle rule is declared as deployable Azure infrastructure.
COULD BE USED · MICROSOFT DEFENDER FOR CLOUD

Continuously assess the cloud workload.

Defender for Cloud could add serverless-container posture checks, registry image vulnerability findings and cloud attack-path context before a revision reaches viewers.

  • Surface risky configuration and exposed resources.
  • Prioritize image vulnerabilities with cloud context.
  • Feed security recommendations into the release desk.
COULD BE USED · FRONT DOOR + API MANAGEMENT + DEFENDER FOR APIs

Put a protected API edge in front.

Azure Front Door WAF could absorb and filter global web traffic. API Management could enforce product policies, quotas and identities, enabling Defender for APIs monitoring.

  • Centralize rate, schema and authentication policy.
  • Detect suspicious parameters and API traffic anomalies.
  • Use Private Link between supported production tiers.
COULD BE USED · MICROSOFT SENTINEL

Turn receipts into detections.

Sentinel could correlate Container Apps, Entra, APIM and BTR audit events into incidents for unusual agent traffic, repeated authorization failures or evidence-tampering attempts.

  • Join application evidence IDs with cloud telemetry.
  • Alert on impossible revision changes or abnormal request bursts.
  • Automate investigation and containment playbooks.
COULD BE USED · FOUNDRY NETWORK ISOLATION

Keep model dependencies on private paths.

A managed virtual network and managed private endpoints could isolate Foundry access to Storage, API Management, Container Registry and monitoring dependencies.

  • Allow only approved outbound destinations.
  • Remove public paths to supported data services.
  • Retain managed identity authorization at each connection.
COULD BE USED · MICROSOFT PURVIEW

Govern the synthetic data lineage.

Purview could catalog datasets and retention policy from synthetic event through calculation, narrative, export and market-specific distribution.

  • Classify partner metadata and generated assets.
  • Document lineage from record ID to screen cue.
  • Apply retention and access policy by region or partner.
COULD BE USED · AZURE KEY VAULT

Protect credentials that cannot be keyless.

Managed identity remains the preferred path. Key Vault could hold rotating partner keys, signing certificates and broadcast credentials when an external integration cannot use Entra.

  • Keep partner secrets out of images and configuration.
  • Rotate and audit certificate access centrally.
  • Grant access to the runtime identity only.
LIVE NON-SECRET RECEIPTInspect the current Azure service state+ Waiting for the service health response…

HONEST SECURITY BOUNDARY

A traceable prototype, not a certification.

BTR demonstrates deployed identity, least privilege, bounded model inputs, claim validation, durable recovery and read-only audience delivery. It has not undergone a penetration test or compliance audit. These products are not connected to this prototype: Defender, Sentinel, Front Door, API Management, Purview, Key Vault and Foundry private networking remain production options.

BEFORE THE ROAR
THE GAME.
MADE PERSONAL.
Watch offers a guided synthetic match that works without AI requests. You can also choose the sixty-second Google Flow film: eight separately generated shots edited into one broadcast package, with manually reviewed moments and four AI discussion checkpoints. The cuts do not establish continuous match play. Choose Synthetic match to follow an authored sequence across Watch, Match Centre and Truth Lab. Its replay is rendered from the same player coordinates.
In synthetic match mode, Scout, Guide, Check and Host each execute a separate sequential Azure model request. Every request receives the completed public handoff from earlier specialists; Vector calculates from event records between Guide and Check. Check’s selected review focus cannot override the deterministic evidence verdict. Public wording remains source-rendered and evidence-bounded. A fresh synthetic round uses four Azure requests; a film round uses up to four when Host needs a revision, with up to three rounds per conversation. Cached rounds use none.
Your original AI film is also available from Watch, and the ninety-minute generator is in Match Lab. No real Premier League match data is used. No league affiliation.
AI responses use the existing daily allowance and cache. Voices use browser speech where supported.
